content: Nagara Yarsho
Goday Museko haysada yaagis;
Neeni Isra7eele asaas haysada yaagada oda; oonika qoponna nagara oothiko woyko Godaa kiitatape issuwa menthiko,
Dooretida kahiney nagara oothidi asaa gomen gathiko, I ba oothida nagaraa gisho borey bayna wofaano Godaas nagara yarsho oothidi eho.
He wofaanuwa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya penge ehidi, huuphen ba kushiya wothidi Godaa sinthan shuko.
Dooretida kahiney wofaanuwa suuthaafe guuthara ekidi Geeshsha Dunkaaniya gelsidi,
ba biradhiya suuthan yeddi ekidi Geeshsha Dunkaaniya magarajuwa sinthan Godaa sinthan laapun toho wurxo.

Kahiney guutha suuthi ekidi Geeshsha Dunkaaniyan Godaa sinthan sawiya ixaane cuyisiya bessan de7iya kaceta tiyo. Attida suuthaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya geliya penge baggara de7iya xuussa yarsho bessa garsan gusso.
Nagara yarshos shuketida wofaanuwa modhuwa ubbaa, ulo ashuwa ma7ida modhuwa,
nam7u kilahota, enta kammida moodhiyanne tiriya xeera baggaa eko.
Issifetetha yarshos shuketida wofaanuwa modhuwa kessidaysada iyape modhuwa kesso. Kahiney xuussa yarsho oothidi yarsho bessan xuuggo.
Shin wofaanuwa galbaa, iya ashuwa ubbaa, iya huuphiya, iya tohota, ulo ashuwa, tociya,
ashuwape attidaysa ubbaa gutaape kare kessidi bido yeggiya woga mela geeshsha bessi efidi yan taman xuuggo.
Isra7eele maabara ubbay qoponna nagara oothikonne Godaa kiitatape issuwa menthiko hessi entafe qosetikoka entaw bala gididi taybetana.
Enti oothida nagaraa akeekiya wode nagara yarshos haniya wofaano Geeshsha Dunkaaniya sinthe eho.
Maabara cimati banta kushiya wofaanuwa huuphen wothidi Godaa sinthan shuko.
Dooretida kahiney wofaanuwa suuthaafe guuthara ekidi Geeshsha Dunkaaniya gido gelo.
I ba biradhiya suuthan yeddi ekidi magarajuwa sintha baggara Godaa sinthan laapun toho wurxo.

Qassi guutha suuthi ekidi, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon Godaa sinthan ixaane cuyisiya bessan de7iya kaceta bolla tiyo. Attida suuthaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya geliya pengiya baggara de7iya xuussa yarsho bessa garsan gusso.
Modho ubbaa ekidi yarsho bessan xuuggo.
Ha wofaanuwaka nagara yarshos shuketida wofaanuwa mela oothada shiisha. Hessada oothidi, kahiney nagara atotetha wogaa polana; asaa nagaray atto geetetana.
Kahiney wofaanuwa gutaape kare kessidi, koyro wofaanoy xuugetidaysada iyaka xuuggo; hessi maabaraas yarshetiya nagara yarsho.
Asaa kaalethiya shuumatape issoy qoponna nagara oothikonne Godaa Xoossaa kiitaape issuwa menthiko he uray bala.
I ba oothida nagaraa akeekidaape guye, borey bayna issi kole eho.
He koliya huuphen ba kushiya wothidi xuussa yarshoy yarshetiya bessan Godaa sinthan shuko; hessi nagara yarsho.
Kahiney ba biradhiya suuthan yeddi ekidi, xuussa yarsho bessan de7iya kaceta bolla tiyo; attida suuthaa qassi xuussa yarsho bessa garsan gusso.
Issifetetha yarshos shiiqida modhuwa ubbaa xuuggidaysada ha koliya modhuwa xuuggo. Hessada oothidi, kahiney he uraa nagara qushisees; he uraa nagaray atto geetetana.
Maabaraape issi asi qoponna nagara oothikonne Godaa kiitaape issuwa menthiko he uray bala gidees.
I ba oothida nagaraa akeekidaape guye borey bayna macca deeshi ba nagaraa gisho eho.
Ba kushiya he deeshe huuphen wotho; yaatidi xuussa yarsho bessan nagara yarsho oothidi shuko.
Hessafe guye, kahiney he deeshe suuthan ba biradhiya yeddi ekidi xuussa yarsho bessan de7iya kaceta bolla tiyo. Attida suutha ubbaa yarsho bessaafe garsan gusso.

Issifetetha yarshos shuketida mehiyape modhuwa kessidaysa mela he deeshe modhuwa qaari kessidi, yarsho bessan Godaas sawo tonku giya yarsho oothidi xuuggo. Hessada oothidi, kahiney he uraa nagaraa qushisees; iya nagaray atto geetetana.
He uray ba nagaraa gisho yarshey dorse gidiko, borey bayna macca dorse gido.
I ba kushiya he dorse huuphen wotho; yaatidi, xuussa yarsho mehe shukiya bessan shuko.
Hessafe guye, kahiney dorse suuthan ba biradhiya yeddi ekidi xuussa yarshoy yarshetiya bessan de7iya kaceta bolla tiyo. Attida suuthaa yarsho bessaafe garsan gusso.

Issifetetha yarshos shuketida mehiyape modhuwa kessidaysada he dorse modhuwa qori kessidi, yarsho bessan Godaas xuussa yarsho oothidi xuuggo. Hessada oothidi, kahiney he uraa nagaraa qushisees; iya nagaray atto geetetana.
